title: How a Godly Man Acts When the Group Chat Isn't Watching
caption:
A godly man is the same guy in the group chat and on his knees. No church version. No group-chat version. One guy.

Notice which version you perform the most, then ask if it survives a Tuesday text thread. Let your jokes pass the same test as your prayers. Say the hard thing in public that you'd already say in private. And let one brother see all three versions of you, so the gap finally closes.

What's confessed heals. What's hidden just multiplies.
